verdict.rationale: Steel's debug URL feature is explicitly documented for human-in-the-loop workflows enabling users to directly interact with and control a live browser session, and runtime proof confirms sessions expose a live debugger/websocket URL for real-time viewing/control. The agent-traces timeline feature complements this by letting engineers review what happened, though it's more post-hoc than live takeover. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mid-run handoff back to the agent after human control, and independent/community corroboration of the human-in-the-loop debug feature specifically (vs. general product commentary).
